items.question: Will the AP2 extension run in production, and where first?
items.context: The extension is specified and Google said AP2 would reach its products starting with Gemini Spark, but no public source shows mandates in a live UCP checkout as of 2026-10-20.

items.question: How many merchants and how much volume?
items.context: Google said on 2026-09-16 that UCP enables direct checkout for hundreds of thousands of brands and retailers across Google, a marketing figure with no definition; no exact merchant count or transaction volume is published, and the only other figures are co-developer and endorser lists.

items.question: Will governance move to a neutral body?
items.context: Google holds proxy votes for open seats until December 2028 and custody of ucp.dev, and there is no foundation. AP2 moved to FIDO; UCP has announced no such move.

items.question: Will non-Google platforms go live on UCP checkout?
items.context: Microsoft requires a UCP-compliant feed for Copilot Checkout and says Merchant Center will support UCP; whether Copilot runs UCP checkout calls, not only feeds, is unclear.

items.question: Will Google Pay on AI surfaces move beyond PAN_ONLY?
items.context: Google's FAQ limits allowed_auth_methods to PAN_ONLY on its AI surfaces, so network tokens and agentic tokens are not in that path today.

items.question: Will UCP and ACP converge or bridge?
items.context: No source supports convergence and no mapping is specified, although Stripe works on both.

items.question: How will merchants consent and measure attribution?
items.context: Shopify's help center confirms that Google direct checkout is on by default for eligible US stores with an opt-out, and attribution gaps on platform surfaces raise questions the spec does not answer; the attribution field carries campaign parameters but no model.

items.question: Can formal models catch negotiation and lifecycle bugs?
items.context: Strabo models UCP checkout declaratively; the two-layer negotiation and backports into dated releases are natural targets for formal checking.
